query: WITH recent_violations AS (SELECT region, gdate_happened FROM estishraf_llm_traffic_violation ORDER BY gdate_happened DESC LIMIT 100000) SELECT input.region, input.violation_count, poly.wkt FROM (SELECT region, COUNT(*) as violation_count FROM recent_violations GROUP BY region ORDER BY violation_count DESC) input JOIN ESTISHRAF_LLM_KSA_Regions_Polygons poly ON input.region = poly.region
raw_question: أريد خريطة توضح آخر 100000 مخالفة مرورية موزعة حسب المنطقة
